autoAcceptRequest.description: Whether or not meeting registration requests are accepted automatically.

requireFirstName.description: Whether or not a registrant's first name is required for meeting registration. This option must always be `true`.

requireLastName.description: Whether or not a registrant's last name is required for meeting registration. This option must always be `true`.

requireEmail.description: Whether or not a registrant's email is required for meeting registration. This option must always be `true`.

requireJobTitle.description: Whether or not a registrant's job title is shown or required for meeting registration.

requireCompanyName.description: Whether or not a registrant's company name is shown or required for meeting registration.

requireAddress1.description: Whether or not a registrant's first address field is shown or required for meeting registration.

requireAddress2.description: Whether or not a registrant's second address field is shown or required for meeting registration.

requireCity.description: Whether or not a registrant's city is shown or required for meeting registration.

requireState.description: Whether or not a registrant's state is shown or required for meeting registration.

requireZipCode.description: Whether or not a registrant's postal code is shown or required for meeting registration.

requireCountryRegion.description: Whether or not a registrant's country or region is shown or required for meeting registration.

requireWorkPhone.description: Whether or not a registrant's work phone number is shown or required for meeting registration.

requireFax.description: Whether or not a registrant's fax number is shown or required for meeting registration.

rules.description: The approval rules for standard questions.
